title: DTCG Extensions for Design Systems
description: Design Lasagna governance metadata carried inside DTCG `$extensions` under the reverse-domain key `recipes.designlasagna`. This is the authoring-side counterpart to v0.3/tokens.json: everything here is human-authored and cannot be derived by a build tool. Resolver output (id, path, resolved, modes) is NOT represented here.

TokenExtensions.description: Value of `$extensions["recipes.designlasagna"]` on a DTCG token.

tier.description: Token tier. Common values: primitive, semantic, component. Inherited from the nearest ancestor group if omitted.

collection.description: Collection key this token belongs to. Must match a key in the manifest `collections` object. Inheritable.

type.description: Granular Lasagna type override for preview rendering (RFC B2b). DTCG `$type` stays coarse (e.g. `dimension`); this narrows it (e.g. `borderRadius`). If omitted, the emitter falls back to DTCG `$type`.

group.description: Human-facing grouping label for docs. Inheritable. Distinct from DTCG group nesting.

priority.description: Autocomplete sort weight (RFC B14). Higher sorts first. Inheritable.

since.description: Version or date the token was introduced.

platforms.description: Per-platform reference overrides. Omit to let the emitter derive references from the naming transform.

relations.description: Relations declared from this token's perspective. The emitter hoists these into the manifest's top-level `tokenRelations` (RFC B7).

metadata.description: Freeform passthrough, copied verbatim to the manifest token's `metadata`.

GroupExtensions.description: Value of `$extensions["recipes.designlasagna"]` on a DTCG group (DTCG 6.3.2). Fields cascade to all descendant tokens unless overridden. Only inheritable fields are permitted here.

type.description: Granular Lasagna type for every descendant. Common case: a `radius` group whose DTCG `$type` is `dimension` but whose Lasagna type is `borderRadius`.

deprecated.description: Deprecates every descendant token. Descendants MAY override with a more specific message.

Deprecated.description: Lifecycle metadata. DTCG `$deprecated` (5.2.4) only carries true|string, so `removal` and `replacement` must live here. Authors SHOULD also set DTCG `$deprecated` to the same message string for cross-tool interop; on conflict this object wins.

removal.description: When it will be removed. ISO date (2026-07-30), semver (3.0.0), or quarter (2026-Q3). ISO dates drive language-server severity escalation.

replacement.description: Machine-readable replacement token id. MUST resolve to an existing token.

allowedProperties.description: CSS properties (or platform-equivalent) this token may be applied to.

wcagContrast.description: Either a single ContrastInfo, or a map keyed by condition key (see docs/condition-keys.md) when contrast differs per mode. Resolves RFC open question 6. Emitters SHOULD compute this rather than require authoring.

against.description: Token id this ratio was measured against.

colorSpace.description: Preferred output color space. Distinct from DTCG `$value.colorSpace`, which describes the authored value.

tokens.description: Other token ids in the relation. The declaring token is implicit and is prepended by the emitter.
